input.command: sed -n '/<script>/,/<\/script>/p' index.html | sed '1d;$d' > "$TMPDIR/s.js" 2>/dev/null || true; node --check "$TMPDIR/s.js" && echo ok

content.text:
I added the ghost piece and pause to `index.html`; the script passes a syntax check, but I haven't run it in a browser. Pausing keeps the piece's lock ticks and resets as they were. Resuming waits only for the rest of the interval that pause cut short, so pausing over and over can't stop the piece from locking.
In the DOM, a ghost cell under the falling piece shows as the piece, not as ghost, but `getState().ghost` always lists all four landing cells.
I rejected restarting the gravity timer on resume, because pausing repeatedly would then keep the piece from ever locking.
